subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I will be joining the office ______ a week’s time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **in**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **“In”** is used in phrases that describe a more general period of time, that doesn't have a specific clock time or time of day.

 
 
• **Example -** *The Games start in Orlando, Florida, in a week's time__.*
